zh: 昨天我把借你的钱还给你了。
old_en: I paid back the money I borrowed from you yesterday.
new_en: I paid you back for the money I borrowed yesterday.

zh: 我上周把欠你的钱还清了。
old_en: I paid back the money I owed you last week.
new_en: I paid off the money I owed you last week.

zh: 因为朋友帮我买了机票，所以我得还钱给他。
old_en: Because my friend bought my plane ticket, I need to pay him back.
new_en: Since my friend bought my plane ticket, I have to pay him back.

zh: 你能提醒我什么时候还钱吗？
old_en: Can you remind me when I need to pay back the money?
new_en: Can you remind me when to pay you back?
